original.statement: Every dispatched request was strictly framed/decoded and admitted within its header/body/deadline budgets; connection capacity is reserved before allocating a handler. Public and private control ingress have separately enforced nonborrowable admission, with combined limits.
original.plannedPassCondition: Model theorem and unique concrete decoder/admission mapping; malformed, ambiguous, oversized and slow requests never dispatch; pre-handler allocation is bounded.

passPredicate: All registered independent Lean contracts, actual source mappings, constructed negative controls, source-bound functional regressions and six advisory reviews pass; two clean offline builds have identical audited empty-axiom inventories and artifacts.

operationalProfile.platform: Linux CPython direct HTTP at a single process, fixed validated TrafficProfile, one public listener and zero or one literal-loopback control listener
operationalProfile.dispatchCut: last successful sampled ingress check before the registered route operation; OS scheduling latency after a sample is not elapsed-time proof
operationalProfile.handlerAllocation: reservation before thread/handler creation; reservation retained until thread has terminated, with at most one accepted-unreserved socket per serialized listener
operationalProfile.body: positive declared length within route limit, exactly that many bytes, strict bounded UTF-8 JSON object, one request per connection
operationalProfile.control: when enabled, independent nonborrowable handler/burst/refill capacities with sums; disabled topology makes no private availability claim

verificationDistinctions.TRUSTED: Lean distribution, registered translators and audits, CPython primitive/stdlib/socket/thread/lock/JSON/regex semantics, monotonic clock sample order, host OS/filesystem/hardware and SHA-256
verificationDistinctions.OUT_OF_SCOPE: unlisted future source revisions, external IIS/Cloudflare HTTP normalization, native Windows/macOS execution, whole-process RSS, kernel resource allocation, distributed traffic and unsampled scheduling latency
